_hints: Slot drop-downs are native <select>s whose option values are slot UUIDs, so pick a slot with keyboard steps (focus the select, ArrowDown, Enter) instead of select_option. Doctors are sorted by name: Dr. Anand Joshi (Demo) is the first card when 'All specialties' is chosen. If a card says 'No free slots in the next 14 days', the demo slots have run out; run `python supabase/seed/seed_demo.py` (idempotent) or use another doctor. Shot 'booked' CREATES one booking for patient4 and must run before 'appointments' (same account). Do not cancel it: cancelling uses a window.confirm dialog. If patient4 already has an upcoming booking, 'booked' can be skipped and 'appointments' still works. 'overview' uses patient1; mark 3 boxes the upcoming card whether it is empty or not.
